fact_check_rounds.label: Round 1: the 40 top-ranked plants profiled (four checkers, one per profiler batch)
Round 2: the 18 plants that entered the top 40 after the audit, leads and job-board sweeps, and the written-key re-rank
Round 3: line check of every High and Medium plant's opening line and bottleneck guess (70 lines), after the rulings
Round 4: confirming pass by other checkers: 44 rewritten and unchecked lines, 9 posting fields, 25 job-posting product rows
Base-record sample: 16 base and 6 excluded records (reported separately; not a profile round)

miss_rate.note: Misses verified by the coordinator against two independent list audits; denominator = included plants matched to an audit list plus audit plants already in the ledger plus verified misses. Upper bound if three disputed records count as misses: 14/63 = 22.2%.
history: 18.3% (consultation 16: a mining record removed from the denominator)

known_limits: Status partial: opening lines and bottleneck guesses failed two checks, 20/70 = 28.6% (round 3) and 10/44 = 22.7% (round 4 confirming pass). Round 4 pooled is 14/105 = 13.3%; its facts part (9 posting fields, 25 job-posting product rows) was 4/61 = 6.6%. Every flagged line was rewritten, but treat a line as reliable only as far as its cited evidence rows.
Main line errors: job-board re-post dates read as posting dates, expired aggregator postings written as live, announced expansions written as under way, company-wide facts written as the site's.

Eight held plants (welding or enclosure work not shown at the site) sit inside the top-40 ranks and are not profiled; Generac Oshkosh among them has live welder postings, and its air permit could not be downloaded.
Miss rate upper bound is 22.2%, and the second list auditor did not run dry: more plants likely exist.
Yancey Barnesville and Wedlake were found by neither the finders nor the auditors; they came from later sweeps.
Yancey Bros. plants: the enclosures are aluminum-framed and steel is not stated on a Yancey source, so material scores 4 (aluminum-first); Path's aluminum claim is unconfirmed.

Yancey Cordele and Fidelity McGregor were profiled while pre-production (fit-out or hiring shown, output not yet shown). A checker read a raw first-posted date of 2026-06-30 for Cordele's welder role (about 140 days); not yet on an evidence row, so labor stays 12.

Hennig Machesney Park (72 High): its 8 counted welder postings give no street address; the tie to this record is inferred from the board label, so labor and process earn points but no confidence (confidence 3). If the tie fails, Hennig is 32 Low.
Phoenix Products Zoo Pkwy labor rests on Service Fabricator roles that weld.
Generac Eagle's membership rests on an archived 2022 Generac page that the profiler read once and that no checker could reopen.
Pritchard Brown passes the prospect test on its own undated construction spec (welded steel floor and underframe) and a single facility; no source names welding in Baltimore.
